about.intro: How the service works, what is stored about you and the session – and how to run Riskmatris Live yourself.
about.title: About the service
about.whatIs.body: An open-source tool for real-time group risk assessment – e.g. alongside a PowerPoint presentation. The facilitator starts a session, participants join with the session code or QR code and vote anonymously straight from their phones. No accounts, no sign-in.
about.howWorks.body: For each risk, participants vote on Probability (1–4) and Consequence (1–4). Once the vote threshold is reached – or when the facilitator clicks "Show results now" – the result appears in a 4×4 matrix in real time. The facilitator can then lock each risk's placement and export the summary as a PNG image or CSV file.

about.restart.strong: Does it survive a server restart?
about.restart.body: Yes. Sessions are also kept in a local database (SQLite; a Docker volume when containerized), so ongoing sessions survive a restart – until they are automatically deleted when the retention period expires.
about.careful.body: Everything in the session can be viewed and downloaded by anyone who has the session code. Never enter sensitive data, personal data or confidential information – and only share the code with people who should participate.
about.security.strong: How is the session code protected?
about.security.body: The code is 8 random characters and the read API is rate-limited per IP, so codes cannot be brute-forced. An admin-transfer link is single-use and expires after 5 minutes.
about.cookies.body: The service uses no cookies. On your own device only a randomly generated client key (needed to vote), your recent sessions and your chosen language and theme are stored – all in the browser's local storage.
about.ip.body: To protect the service against abuse, IP addresses are handled temporarily in the server's memory and logs, and the API is rate-limited per IP. They are never used for tracking and are never stored in the session data.
about.faq1a: Yes – each vote is only linked to a random client key, never to a name or account. Remember that anyone with the session code can see the votes.
about.faq2q: Does it work without internet, e.g. on an office network?
about.faq2a: Yes. When you run the service locally, the QR code automatically points to the computer's local IP address, so phones on the same Wi-Fi/network can join directly.
about.faq3q: Can I save a session and continue later?
about.faq3a: Yes – export a snapshot (JSON) from the admin view and import it later via "Resume a saved session" on the home page, with or without previous votes.
about.faq4q: Can I change language or theme?
about.faq4a: Yes – use the language selector and theme toggle in the top-right corner. Your choice is stored locally in the browser.
